Briefing: Drone Mapping for Income + Carbon Credits – Northern Cape Focus
Overview
The Northern Cape's vast open terrain, major solar farms (e.g., near Upington/Kathu),
mining sites, and land restoration/conservation needs create strong demand for drone
mapping. This can generate paid work while collecting high-resolution data to support
carbon credit MRV (biomass, soil health, vegetation monitoring) in renewables, mining
rehab, regenerative agriculture, and dryland restoration—aligning with SACAA regs and
standards like Verra.
Paid Opportunities
Two models connect certified operators to clients:
• Platform 1 (Automated): Short app-guided missions with lightweight drones; per-
mission rewards, bi-weekly payouts.
• Platform 2 (Gig Marketplace): Bid on custom jobs (e.g., solar inspections, mining
surveys); higher per-project pay, invoiced post-delivery.
Potential Earnings
• Platform 1: $40–$50+/hour or $500+/day in dense zones; typical $5–$20 per
mission. Good for flexible side income in open areas.
• Platform 2: $100–$500+ per job ($50–$150+/hour); higher in
solar/mining/environmental gigs.
Recurring Potential
• Platform 1: On-demand, repeatable flights as needed; supports ongoing effort via
app map and bi-weekly payouts.
• Platform 2: Project-based but allows subscriptions (e.g., monthly solar checks,
quarterly rehab monitoring); repeat clients possible in renewables/mining.
Carbon Credit Integration
Drones cut MRV costs by up to 50% with detailed imagery/3D models for sequestration
estimates in restoration, regenerative land use, or solar-adjacent offsets.
• Platform 1: Earn while mapping sites (e.g., Kalahari areas); feed data to AI for
periodic tracking.
• Platform 2: Source custom missions (multispectral/LiDAR) or subscriptions;
integrate via APIs for hybrid satellite-drone accuracy.
Next Steps
• Get SACAA RPAS certification + drone registration (essential for commercial pay;
clearances near Upington Airport).
• Register on platforms; highlight Northern Cape access.
• Pilot a local site (e.g., solar buffer or restoration plot) to test revenue + data value.
